players.bio: Abel Bretones Cruz (born 21 August 2000) is a Spanish footballer who plays as either a left back or a left winger for CA Osasuna.
Aimar Oroz Huarte (born 27 November 2001) is a Spanish footballer who plays for CA Osasuna as a midfielder.

Aitor Fernández Abarisketa (born 3 May 1991) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays for CA Osasuna as a goalkeeper. Fernández made his debut for the unofficial Basque Country national team on 30 May 2019, in a 0–0 draw away to Panama for which a small, youthful and inexperienced squad was selected.
Alejandro Catena Marugán (born 28 October 1994) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for La Liga club Osasuna.
Ante Budimir (born 22 July 1991) is a Croatian professional footballer who plays as a striker for La Liga club Osasuna and the Croatia national team.
Asier Osambela Larraya (born 30 October 2004) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for CA Osasuna .
Diego Rico Salguero (born 23 February 1993) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a left-back for La Liga club Getafe CF.
Flavien Enzo Thiédort Boyomo (born 7 October 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for La Liga club Osasuna. Born in France, he represents the Cameroon national team.

Iker Muñoz Cameros (born 5 November 2002) is a Spanish footballer who plays as a midfielder for CA Osasuna. Born in Villafranca, Navarre, Muñoz joined CA Osasuna's youth setup in 2018, from CD Oberena. On 9 April of the following year, he renewed his contract until 2021.
Iñigo Arguibide Goñi (born 19 April 2005) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays for CA Osasuna B. Mainly a right-back, he can also play as a right winger.
Jagoba Arrasate Elustondo (born 22 April 1978) is a Spanish former footballer who played as a forward. He is currently manager of Osasuna and the Basque Country national team.
Jon Moncayola Tollar (born 13 May 1998) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder or right-back for La Liga club Osasuna.
Jonathan Dubasin (born 2 February 2000) is a footballer who plays as a left winger for Spanish club CA Osasuna. Born in Spain, he represented Belgium at under-19 level.
Jorge Herrando Oroz (born 28 February 2001) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays for CA Osasuna as a central defender.
Enrique "Kike" Barja Afonso (born 1 April 1997) is a Spanish footballer who plays for CA Osasuna mainly as a right winger.
Lucas Torró Marset (born 19 July 1994) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays for La Liga club Osasuna as a central midfielder.
Moisés 'Moi' Gómez Bordonado (born 23 June 1994) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for La Liga club CA Osasuna.
Raúl García de Haro (born 3 November 2000) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a forward for La Liga club Osasuna.
Raúl Moro Prescoli (born 5 December 2002) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a winger for Eredivisie club Ajax.

Rubén García Santos (born 14 July 1993) is a Spanish footballer who plays for CA Osasuna as a left winger. Levante Born in Valencia, Valencian Community, García graduated from local Levante UD's youth system, making his senior debut with the reserves in Tercera División.
Sergio Herrera Pirón (born 5 June 1993) is a Spanish footballer who plays for CA Osasuna as a goalkeeper.
Unai Santos Mañeru (born 3 November 2005) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for CA Osasuna.
Valentin André Henri Rosier (born 19 August 1996) is a French professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Spanish club CA Osasuna.
